aboutGame.title: What is Chained Beasts?
paragraphs: Chained Beasts is a 1–4 player co-op gladiator roguelite from Featherweight Games. Each gladiator is physically chained to their teammates, turning every dodge, charge, and weapon throw into a shared movement problem. Runs span nine battles across three acts, with arena champions waiting at the end of each stretch.

Between fights, players learn skills, spend coin on weapons and equipment, earn crowd favor, and unlock new characters. Wounds persist across days in the arena, and potions can trade pain relief for new afflictions, so a strong run depends on chain discipline, careful healing, and using hazards such as urns, spike walls, and snake pits.

explore.title: Explore Chained Beasts
explore.description: Use these Chained Beasts guides to learn the chain, master arena combat, choose a role, plan progression, and track post-launch updates.

modules.name: Chained Beasts Beginner Guide
modules.description: Learn the chain tether, basic combat, arena hazards, healing choices, and the opening steps that keep a new gladiator alive.

highlights.detail: Finish the blocking and throwing tutorial before entering a live arena run.
Keep the chain visible, call your movement, and practice a chain trip in open ground.
Identify a replacement weapon before every throw so you are never caught empty-handed.
Use the scorecard's Variety, Tempo, and Carnage rows to choose one improvement for the next fight.
Treat potions carefully and pick an affliction that leaves your main attack usable.

modules.name: Chained Beasts Gameplay Guide
modules.description: Understand the run structure, crowd favor, skill choices, weapon economy, and shared chain movement that define every arena attempt.

highlights.label: 9 Battles
highlights.detail: Each run spans nine battles across three acts, with a boss at the end of each stretch.

highlights.label: Chain
highlights.detail: A deliberate sweep can trip enemies and open backstab windows without spending ammo.

highlights.label: Crowd
highlights.detail: Crowd favor compounds during a run and feeds rewards, upgrades, and character progress.

highlights.label: Skills
highlights.detail: More than 70 skills are available, so choose upgrades that support the build already in hand.

highlights.label: Throws
highlights.detail: Weapon throws add ranged pressure, but keep a replacement nearby before committing.

modules.name: Chained Beasts Characters and Beasts
modules.description: Compare gladiator kits, unlock routes, role archetypes, and team compositions for solo, duo, and four-player chains.

highlights.label: Frontliner
highlights.detail: Starts fights, pressures enemies, and absorbs attention while the chain holds formation.

highlights.label: Anchor
highlights.detail: Holds ground, controls space, and calls the direction when the squad wraps around a pillar.

highlights.label: Chaos
highlights.detail: Turns urns, spike walls, and snake pits into damage while ranging wide on the chain.

highlights.label: Support
highlights.detail: Manages coin, potions, crowd favor, and recovery so the squad can regroup.

highlights.label: Unlocks
highlights.detail: Crowd favor, coin, boss clears, and 60 Steam achievements drive character unlocks.

modules.name: Chained Beasts Combat Guide
modules.description: Study boss tells, chain trips, hazard kills, wound management, and the phase-by-phase tactics used against arena champions.

highlights.detail: Read the champion's opening tells before spending weapons, potions, or crowd favor.
Keep the Anchor closest to the boss and call every dodge so the chain does not drag a teammate into a swing.
Sweep a taut chain across the boss's charge path to create a knockdown and a safe follow-up window.
Treat wounds before the gate; potions and surgery are safer between fights than during a champion encounter.
Finish with throw-and-swap pressure or redirect the boss into a spike wall or snake pit.

modules.name: Chained Beasts Progression Guide
modules.description: Plan coin spending, skill picks, character unlocks, injury treatment, and the route from early arena waves to Rome.

highlights.label: Coin
highlights.detail: Bank a portion every run and buy one run-defining weapon instead of three small upgrades.

highlights.label: Skills
highlights.detail: Take skills that patch your worst matchup rather than stacking damage for an easy one.

highlights.label: Unlocks
highlights.detail: Push deeper for boss clears and use crowd favor, coin, and achievements to expand the roster.

highlights.label: Wounds
highlights.detail: Carry manageable injuries and treat the ones that break your main attack before the next boss.

modules.name: Chained Beasts Tips and Tricks
modules.description: Use practical chain positioning, throw-and-swap routines, potion timing, and crowd-favor habits to avoid common run-ending mistakes.

highlights.label: Chain
highlights.detail: Set the trip line before a wave reaches you, and retrace your movement when the links wrap a pillar.

highlights.label: Throws
highlights.detail: Call the throw, plant your feet, and confirm a replacement weapon before releasing.

highlights.label: Potions
highlights.detail: Drink early enough for side effects to settle before the next gate, not during a boss wind-up.

highlights.label: Crowd
highlights.detail: Environmental kills and flashy finishers build favor faster than safe chip damage.

highlights.label: Surgery
highlights.detail: Save the heavier fix for downtime between fights instead of a live brawl.

modules.name: Chained Beasts Tier List
modules.description: Rank the four co-op roles by chain stability, beginner comfort, and boss utility, then adjust for your squad size and unlocked gladiators.

highlights.label: S
highlights.detail: Anchor — best chain stability: holds ground, calls the unwind, and keeps a tangled squad calm.

highlights.label: A
highlights.detail: Frontliner — sets the tempo and baits boss swings, but needs a partner who will not yank the chain mid-swing.

highlights.label: B
highlights.detail: Chaos-Maker — turns arena hazards into damage, with more risk when the formation is tight.

highlights.label: C
highlights.detail: Quartermaster — handles coin, potions, crowd favor, and recovery; strongest across a full run rather than one fight.

items.question: What is Chained Beasts?
items.answer: Chained Beasts is a 1–4 player co-op gladiator roguelite from Featherweight Games. Players are chained together in the arena, fight through nine battles across three acts, and use skills, weapons, crowd favor, and persistent wounds to push toward Rome.

items.question: How many players can play Chained Beasts?
items.answer: Chained Beasts supports one to four players, with online co-op, shared and split-screen play, cross-platform multiplayer, and Remote Play Together.

items.question: How does the chain work in Chained Beasts?
items.answer: Every Chained Beasts gladiator is physically linked to their teammates. The chain can trip enemies and create backstab windows, but it also shares movement, so a dodge or retreat can pull the whole group out of position.

items.question: What should beginners do first in Chained Beasts?
items.answer: New Chained Beasts players should finish the blocking and throwing tutorial, practice a chain trip in open ground, and confirm a replacement weapon before throwing.

items.question: When did Chained Beasts release?
items.answer: Chained Beasts launched on October 15, 2026 for Windows and macOS through Steam. A free demo is available, and the standard price is $19.99.
